svg.title: Knuth-Morris-Pratt (KMP) Algorithm: LPS Failure Table and Monotonic Text Scan
svg.desc: Animated step-by-step diagram of the KMP string matching algorithm showing precomputed pi (LPS) table for pattern ABABD, text pointer i advancing monotonically without backtracking through text ABABCABABD, mismatch at i=4 triggering j = pi[3] = 2 pattern shift, and final match at index 5.
svg.text: Knuth-Morris-Pratt (KMP) · LPS / π Failure Table & Zero-Backtrack Scan
Text pointer i advances monotonically in O(n); mismatch at j retreats pattern pointer via j = π[j - 1] in O(m) space
1. Precomputed π (LPS) Array on Pattern P = "ABABD" (m = 5)
π[i] = max { k : 0 <= k < i and P[0..k-1] = P[i-k+1..i] }

g.text: i increments <= n times; NEVER decrements.
j increments <= n times; j >= 0 bounds π jumps.
Potential Φ = j: every failure transition strictly decreases Φ by at least 1, so total work <= 2n.

svg.text: 3. Live Alignment Trace: Text T = "ABABCABABD" (n = 10) vs Pattern P = "ABABD" (m = 5)

g.text: i and j advance together to 4.
Match at i - m = 5 in O(n+m).
